adaptations.reason: docker-publish.yml#build-and-push 'Log in to Container Registry' has no if: upstream; the login only serves the push, and nothing may be published from the benchmark repo. Off in every configuration. Step index 3 = upstream step 2 + the harness step at index 0.

docker-publish.yml#build-and-push 'Build and push Docker image' has push: true with no upstream condition; it would publish ghcr.io/<owner>/prompts.chat. Set to false in every configuration: both platform builds and the gha cache read/write still run in full; only the final registry upload is skipped (timed-path change, disclosed in kit.md). Step index 5 = upstream step 4 + the harness step at index 0.
